gemini.title: Census Area Explorer Migration Data 2021 Lgd
gemini.abstract: Census Area Explorer Migration Data 2021 Lgd is an authoritative dataset published by Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency. It contains records relating to census area explorer migration data 2021 lgd.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
gemini.responsible_organisation: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency

columns.name: geocode
columns.description: Code identifying the geographical area represented by the row.

columns.name: geography
columns.description: Name or descriptive label of the geographical area represented by the row.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Reference year recorded for the statistical observation.

columns.name: address_one_year_ago_different_address_within_northern_ireland
columns.description: Recorded census measure for the category "address one year ago different address within northern ireland" in the represented area. Units and population base require the source table.

columns.name: address_one_year_ago_lived_at_same_address
